The memo accurately reflects the key financial and legal terms present in the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Date (October 26, 2020) is correct
- Entity names (PNM Resources, Inc., Wells Fargo Bank, MUFG Bank, Ltd., etc.) are accurate
- The 25% beneficial ownership threshold for Change of Control is correctly stated
- Merger Agreement date (October 20, 2020) and parties (Avangrid, Inc., NM Green Holdings, Inc.) are accurate
- References to underlying credit agreement dates (July 30, 2018 and December 19, 2018) are correct
- The memo appropriately notes that core financial terms like interest rates, loan amounts, and maturity dates are not disclosed in this Amendment document
- Covenant modifications and waiver terms are accurately described
- The legal structure and purpose of the Amendment are correctly summarized

The memo does not contain any fabricated financial terms or details not present in the source document.

MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms available in the source document. This is an amendment to an existing credit agreement, and the source document does not contain core financial terms like interest rates, loan amounts, or maturity dates - it only contains amendment-specific provisions. The memo correctly identifies this limitation in the Key Deal Terms Table with "N/A" entries and includes an explanatory note that "Core financial terms of the underlying credit agreement are not disclosed in this Amendment."

All material terms present in the source document are captured in the memo, including:
- Parties (borrower, administrative agent, lenders)
- Amendment effective date (October 26, 2020)
- Key covenant modifications (Change of Control definition, Section 8.2 amendments)
- Waiver provisions and their limitations
- The underlying merger agreement details (October 20, 2020 with Avangrid, Inc.)
